other_conditions: The applicant must be registered with the Haryana Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
A minimum of one year of regular membership with the Board is required
The worker must have an active membership at the time of claim
The worker must be admitted to a government or government‑approved private hospital for treatment for 4 to 30 days due to an accident or illness
Assistance can be availed for a period not exceeding one month in a year
To claim benefits, the worker must have at least 90 days of work experience in the preceding year and pay the registration fee
benefits_summary: Provides wage compensation or financial assistance to registered construction workers admitted to a government or empanelled private hospital for 4 to 30 days.
